WikiPage.label: Pages Wiki
WikiPage.schema: CREATE TABLE wiki_pages (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(255), date DATETIME, content TEXT, intro TEXT, seoDesc TEXT, draft TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0, img VARCHAR(255), version INT DEFAULT 1, lastModified DATETIME, modifiedBy VARCHAR(100), slug VARCHAR(255), position INT DEFAULT 0, categories TEXT)

WikiPageHistory.label: Historique Wiki
WikiPageHistory.schema: CREATE TABLE wiki_history (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, pageId INT, version INT, name VARCHAR(255), content TEXT, intro TEXT, seoDesc TEXT, modifiedBy VARCHAR(100), modifiedAt DATETIME, changeDescription TEXT)

WikiActivity.label: Activité Wiki
WikiActivity.schema: CREATE TABLE wiki_activities (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, action VARCHAR(50), pageName VARCHAR(255), categoryName VARCHAR(255), pageId INT, timestamp INT, date DATETIME)
